description: Set items' width and height in points (Transform panel W and H) around a reference point. With constrainProportions and one dimension, the other follows. With relative, the values are added to the current size (e.g. width: 10 makes it 10 pt wider). For percentages use scale_items

constrainProportions.description: Keep the width to height ratio when only one is given (Constrain Width and Height Proportions). Default true

origin.description: Reference point each item transforms around. Default center

relative.description: Add width and height to the current size. Default false

scaleCorners.description: Scale live corner radii with the object (Scale Corners). Default: the current setting

scaleStrokes.description: Scale stroke weights. Default: the Scale Strokes & Effects preference

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

transformPatterns.description: Scale pattern fills too. Default true

usePreviewBounds.description: Measure including strokes and effects. Default: the Use Preview Bounds preference

name: resize_items
title: Resize Items
